attempts.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RHEL7) via openssl, installed its certificate into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and ran update-ca-trust extract to register it as a trusted system CA. Verified trust functionally by issuing a test leaf certificate and confirming openssl verify accepted it against the system default trust store. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a pre-restart boot_id and healthy-trust baseline, rebooted node1 via shutdown -r now, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA anchor file, trust-list entry, ca-bundle inclusion, and end-to-end leaf-certificate verification all recovered post-reboot.
